item1.question: Is the estimate really free?
item1.answer: Yes. Tell us what you have in mind, and we’ll start with a conversation about your property and a free estimate.

item2.question: What should I include in my message?
item2.answer: Your city, the kind of care you’re looking for, and a little about your outdoor space are a great start. If you have a preferred time of year or a particular area that needs attention, mention that too.

item3.question: Can I ask about more than one service?
item3.answer: Absolutely. Choose “A few things / not sure yet” and tell us about the work you’re considering. We can talk through the options together.

item4.question: Do you work with businesses as well as homeowners?
item4.answer: Yes. Flores offers landscaping and property care for residential and commercial properties in {{city}} and nearby communities.
